slot.brief: Two straightforward universal/affirmative statements (All A are B, All B are C) with two conclusions; ask which conclusions definitely follow, keeping it at beginner level with no negatives or possibilities.

stem:
**Statements:**
All cedars are trees.
All trees are plants.

**Conclusions:**
I. All cedars are plants.
II. All plants are cedars.

verdicts.working: Cedars ⊆ trees and trees ⊆ plants, so cedars ⊆ plants. The statements do not imply plants ⊆ cedars.

working:
Cedars ⊆ trees ⊆ plants, so conclusion I follows. The inclusion need not reverse; conclusion II does not follow.

Independent check: Cedars ⊆ trees and trees ⊆ plants, so cedars ⊆ plants. The statements do not imply plants ⊆ cedars.
solution: Since cedars are trees and trees are plants, cedars are plants; hence conclusion I follows. The inclusion cannot be reversed, so conclusion II does not follow.
